div.div:
1. Use Tech stack:
Framework - React
Build Library - Vite
CSS Library - Tailwind
Routing Library - React Router Dom
State Management - Redux / ReactQuery
Unit Testing - Vitest
linting & formatting - Eslint/Prettier
Axios (Axios Interceptor)
Accessibility
Heroicons
2. Map all legacy features in React Modern equivalent component
3. Responsive design for devices (Mobile, Tablet and desktop)
4. web browser compatible components
5. Generate application
